The fintech industry has witnessed a significant shift in recent years, with digital payments becoming an increasingly dominant force in the way people and businesses conduct transactions. The company's innovative approach to payment processing has made it a favorite among businesses and consumers alike, with over 50% of the world's online transactions passing through Stripe's platform (3).
